cmd:
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN= /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
D=/opt/trading-bot/classic
for f in classic_strategy classic_pos_html classic_panel; do cp $D/$f.py $D/$f.py.bak_before_tl; done
for f in classic_strategy classic_pos_html classic_panel classic_trendline; do curl -sfH "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/$f.py" -o $D/$f.py; done
chown -R tbot:tbot $D
for f in classic_strategy classic_pos_html classic_panel classic_trendline; do /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python -m py_compile $D/$f.py && echo COMPILED $f; done
systemctl restart classicbot; sleep 10; systemctl is-active classicbot
/opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python - <<EOF
import json, urllib.request
for tf in ("4h","1h","15m"):
    j=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:18093/api/chart?sym=ZECUSDT&tf="+tf, timeout=60))
    t=j.get("tl",{})
    print(tf, "|", t.get("label"), "| линии:", {k:(round(v["s"],4),v["broken"],v["i1"],v["i2"]) for k,v in t.get("lines",{}).items()}, "| сигналов:", len(t.get("sigs",[])), "| окно", len(j["t"]))
EOF
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:18093/ | grep -c "Линии тренда"
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8091/ | grep -c "tl_bounce"
